content: To love truth with all one's soul requires having unmasked every comforting lie of the ego.
author: François de La Rochefoucauld
story:
This insight touches directly on the messy reality of human nature. From childhood, we are trained to fit in, to smooth over our eccentricities, and to mirror the expectations of those around us. But copying others only buys superficial acceptance at the cost of your own soul.

In François de La Rochefoucauld's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. Your unique perspective and lived contradictions are your greatest offering to the world. The moment you stop performing and stand firmly in your own skin, you command an authority that imitation can never manufacture.
reflectionPrompt: What hidden motive, insecurity, or fear might be silently driving your recent reactions?
